verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a professional-services law firm offering attorney counsel on fintech, IP, corporate, privacy and employment matters, not a software product with user data to analyze. In-product AI-generated insights from user data is therefore a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any software product: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404, and its practice pages describe only human legal services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
